elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 14.2(b)(i) applies upon expiration or termination for any reason and obligates Array, at Ono's request, to provide reasonable transition assistance to Ono, its Affiliates, and designees.

elements.element: The transition-assistance period must be available for up to six months following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 14.2(b)(i) expressly provides assistance for up to six months following the effective date of expiration or termination.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Return is conditional on Ono making a written request and excludes Data or Ono Know-How that Array is licensed or otherwise entitled to use or retain. The required automatic return of Customer Data upon the exit event is therefore absent.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day period runs from Ono's written request, not from the effective date of expiration or termination. A delayed or omitted request can defer or eliminate return.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 14.2(b)(ii) requires return in a commonly used, machine-readable format, which satisfies this format requirement.

elements.element: After return, Vendor must delete Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 14.2(b)(iii) permits Array to retain one archival copy, while subsection (ii) also excludes Data that Array is entitled to retain. It therefore does not require deletion of all Customer Data.

elements.element: Vendor must thereafter certify deletion of Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: Although Array must provide a written certification, it certifies only the limited deletion or destruction required by subsection (iii), which is subject to an archival-copy exception and does not cover excluded retained Data.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 14.2(b)(i) imposes that assistance obligation upon expiration or termination for any reason, exercisable at Ono's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days following expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available for up to six months following the effective date, which encompasses a requested 90-day period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must export Customer Data to Customer.
elements.evidence: The machine-readable return functions as an export, but it is conditional on Ono's written request rather than automatically required upon expiry or termination.

elements.element: The Customer Data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The operative deadline is 30 days after Ono's written request, so export is not guaranteed within 30 days after the exit event.

result.reason: Neither level is fully satisfied because data return/export is request-dependent and its deadline runs from the request rather than expiry or termination. The preferred deletion position also fails because Array may retain an archival copy and other entitled Data, so the certification does not cover complete deletion. The redline is not minimal and does not preserve unrelated commercial intent because it also adds a substantial new subsection (ix) governing consideration and dispute resolution for regulatory, know-how, improvement, and patent rights. Drafting quality is further reduced by the displaced sentence fragment beginning 'with Ono's obligations' and the awkward phrase 'make such rights for consideration.'
